headline: Enhance ClearInstall with Real-Time Risk Assessment
summary: Integrate real-time risk assessment capabilities into ClearInstall to provide users with up-to-date security and compatibility information. Leverage AI-driven analysis for npm/PyPI packages, including binding.gyp command expansion, to ensure safer installations.
actions: Implement an AI-driven scanner that continuously monitors package repositories for vulnerabilities and risks, providing real-time updates before installation.
Develop a feature that analyzes the contents of `binding.gyp` files to identify potential security issues or compatibility problems with local systems.
Integrate machine learning models to predict and alert users about potential conflicts between installed packages and system configurations.
